remarks: Fantastic opportunity to own in one of North Stamford's most desirable and convenient neighborhoods, surrounded by higher-value homes. This prime 1.08-acre parcel boasts an impressive 335 feet of street frontage, offering exceptional potential for expansion, renovation, or a complete custom build. The cape-style home is positioned on a beautifully level lot, gently elevated on a natural knoll that provides privacy, natural light, and year-round serenity. Builders and visionaries take note: whether you choose to craft a new luxury residence from the ground up or transform the existing structure, the setting and proportions of this property are ideal. Enjoy the best of both worlds-peaceful, wooded surroundings with the convenience of being just minutes to shopping, dining, schools, and commuting routes. Property to be sold as-is.
